overview: The Artisan’s Crescent is the doctrinal craft district of Sanctus Seru, where purity-approved artisans create sanctioned works.
history: Founded to centralize Seru’s artisan guilds under doctrinal oversight.
Purity-screened workshops were added to prevent ideological corruption.
Resonance-aligned studios were introduced to stabilize arcane craftsmanship.
Praetorian guild monitors were integrated to enforce decree compliance.
hooks: A workshop reports a resonance anomaly.
A decree-regulated guild hall experiences a purity flare.
A Praetorian guild monitor requests assistance with a craft edict.
A sanctioned artisan disappears after producing a forbidden piece.
